categories.main_business_segments: Jirfine Intelligent Equipment Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of CNC machine tools, including vertical machining centers, gantry machining centers, horizontal machining centers, CNC lathes, and grinding machines. Their products serve industries such as general equipment manufacturing, consumer electronics, automotive parts, molds, aerospace, and communications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced CNC technology with high precision and rigidity, including high-speed spindles, integrated motor seats, and modular production systems. They emphasize unitized and modular manufacturing to enhance efficiency and product consistency. Key technologies include high-precision guide rails, spindle development, and multi-axis machining centers, supported by collaborations with universities and extensive R&D investment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jirfine serves a broad range of customers in sectors like new energy vehicles, aerospace, 3C electronics, automotive parts, molds, and general machinery. Their customer base includes large industry leaders, with a focus on providing customized solutions to meet specific industry needs, especially in high-growth strategic sectors such as new energy and aerospace.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with production bases in the Pearl River Delta and Yangtze River Delta regions, which are major manufacturing hubs. They have a small but growing presence in overseas markets, though domestic sales dominate their revenue. They maintain a nationwide service network with 37 service points across China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jirfine operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing CNC machine tools and related equipment. They procure key components like CNC systems, castings, guide rails, and spindles from established international suppliers and integrate these into finished products for end users in manufacturing industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-precision, high-rigidity CNC machine tools, focusing on core components such as spindles and rotary tables to reduce import dependence. R&D efforts target multi-axis machining centers, grinding machines, and automation integration, with projects aimed at serving new energy vehicles, aerospace, and 3C industries. They emphasize talent development, digital transformation, and building an intelligent manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of CNC machine tools and related equipment, with a sales model combining direct sales and authorized distributors. They also provide customized solutions and after-sales services, with revenue recognized upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jirfine is positioned in the second tier of the Chinese CNC machine tool industry, competing with large state-owned enterprises and private companies with strong R&D capabilities. The industry is fragmented with many small players; Jirfine ranks among the top in the metal cutting machine tool segment domestically, holding about 1.05% market share in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jirfine reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.76 billion, a 21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 205 million, up 21%. The company has expanded production capacity with new facilities and has shown steady growth in sales volume and production output. Total assets reached RMB 3.32 billion, reflecting significant growth and capital raising through IPO.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jirfine emphasizes high precision, reliability, and customization in its CNC machine tools, supported by strong R&D and quality control systems. Their modular and unitized production approach ensures consistent product quality and shorter lead times. The company offers integrated 'machine tool + process + service' solutions tailored to strategic industries, leveraging local market insights and responsive customer service to differentiate from competitors.
